title: The Good Samaritan
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child narrates the Good Samaritan (Luke 10:30-37) and names lessons: help people in need, love your neighbour, kindness to all.

floor.prerequisite: Knows compassion from the healing stories.
floor.question: What does it mean to show compassion?
floor.answer: To care for someone who is suffering

representations: a road drawn from Jerusalem to Jericho
contexts: a child who falls on the playground
a new pupil from another county

board.say: What did he do that the others did not?

board.do: Wait for the child to say he stopped and helped.

misconceptions.repair: Act out the three passers-by. Ask who stopped.

listen_for: The person who lived next to him
misconceptions.ask: In the story, who was a neighbour to the wounded man?
misconceptions.repair: Read Luke 10:36-37. A neighbour is anyone we help.

misconceptions.ask: Should we help someone from another community who is hurt?
misconceptions.repair: Say that Samaritans and Jews did not get along, yet he helped.

listen_for: He left him on the road
misconceptions.ask: Where did the Samaritan take the man?
misconceptions.repair: Read Luke 10:34-35. Count the steps of help.

checks.question: Name a lesson from the story.
checks.answer: Help people in need (love your neighbour)
